result.summary: The interface is clean, but has minor truncation and contrast issues.

issues.description: The item title 'Trattoria Piccol' is abruptly truncated at the screen edge without an ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Implement text-overflow: ellipsis to handle truncated text gracefully.

issues.description: The light green subtext in the promo banner has low contrast against the background.
issues.suggestion: Increase the contrast ratio of the banner subtext to improve readability.
